svg.title: ObservedState.dev hosting architecture
svg.desc: Reader to Route 53 to CloudFront with a viewer-request function, ACM certificate, and a private S3 bucket reached through Origin Access Control, all in the stacknimbus AWS account.
svg.text: observedstate.dev: static Astro site, private S3 origin, HTTPS only
A and AAAA alias: apex + www
No other principal can read the bucket
HTML and other files: public, max-age=300
public ACLs or public bucket policy
solid = request path dashed = configuration or lookup
